metadata.description: The NarrativeTrace agent skills for Python.

plugins.name: narrativetrace-python
plugins.description: Install NarrativeTrace in a Python project and reach a first trace, diagnose an install that traces nothing, add a naming-clarity report and gate, report a defect in NarrativeTrace itself, verify a change by reading what the code actually did, debug a wrong result by the span where its value diverged, and explain what an application actually does by reading the trace of one run.
